description:
The Dark Tower: The Gunslinger did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. The Dark Tower: The Gunslinger is a dark-fantasy novel by American author Stephen King. The Gunslinger was first published in 1982 as a fix-up novel, joining five short stories that had been published between 1978 and 1981.

The Dark Tower: The Gunslinger did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. In the expanded edition of the novel, on the last page before the text, the word RESUMPTION appears. In the "Argument" foreword for Wolves of the Calla, King explains that this is the subtitle of the novel.
